findings.F1: Step 5's result points the way the idea predicts but falls short of the bar: the mean unusual 7-day move is +1.42 % per case (strength 0.087, t 1.28 over 140 case-days, 162 cases), and the supporting check could not be read (None). The test lacks the evidence to decide, and its effect is not wrong-signed.
findings.F2: In folds B and C, the in-profile 7-day cases where the reading is at least 1 number only 26 (BTC 4, ETH 2, LTC 6, XMR 7, XRP 3, ZEC 4). No window holds more than 9 of them. On a grid of non-overlapping cases, the six coins give too few cases to tell a 0.09 strength from zero.
findings.F3: Inside those cases the effect is graded the way the idea says. By forecast tercile the unusual 7-day move is -2.5 % in the low third (t -0.84, 9 cases), +2.6 % in the middle (t 0.50, 8 cases) and +12.8 % in the high third (t 3.14, 9 cases, 6 days). Its correlation with the swing-scaled rise is 0.48. The strongest cases carry the move, while the bar is set by the mean over all cases.
findings.F4: The carry belongs to the choppy calm profile. In the profile, a swing-scaled 14-day rise above 1.5 is followed by +10.3 % over 7 days (strength 0.61, t 2.30, 13 cases). Outside the profile the same bucket gives only +2.9 % (strength 0.18, t 0.83, 85 cases). The tested profile is the right place, so the idea needs more cases rather than a different market.
findings.F5: The result is on the predicted side and the data offer more than the test used. The test ran six coins, but folds A and D hold 13 more coins on daily bars (ADA, DOGE, LINK, TRX, UNI, AAVE, AVAX, SOL, INJ, NEAR, SUI, TAO, ONDO), and folds B and C hold part of six of them. Adding these coins raises the count of independent in-profile cases without narrowing the idea.

ideas.name: swing-rise carry, more coins
ideas.idea: In a choppy, calm market, a coin whose 14-day return is large and positive against its own daily swing over the past 30 days keeps rising over the next 7 days, and the larger that swing-scaled rise, the larger the further rise.
ideas.consequence: Volatility-sized holders keep buying for days after an upward move that is large against a small swing, so the rise carries on.
